name: Christopher Towler
bio: Clinical Associate Professor of Physical Therapy at Clarkson, where he earned both his BS in Biology and his DPT. A board-certified clinical specialist in geriatrics, he practiced in home health and hospice care before returning as faculty; his teaching centers on cardiopulmonary PT and his research on geriatrics and fall-risk identification. He has been quoted nationally as a fall-prevention expert and serves with the Potsdam Volunteer Rescue Squad.
